live_notes: live.strategy selects the rule Get-Signals.ps1 actually trades. 'rsi_revert' is RSI(2) mean reversion on DAILY bars: buy when RSI closes below rsi_buy_below, sell when it closes above rsi_exit_above. It is the only configuration tested in this project that beat a matched random control after correcting for multiple testing (p=0.03, US large caps 2000-2013). Set live.strategy to 'ema_cross' to restore the previous EMA9/21 behaviour, which uses the top-level interval/range/ema_fast/ema_slow values instead. market_close_utc is when the US session ends in UTC (20:00 = 16:00 ET); before that time today's still-forming daily bar is discarded so the rule only ever acts on closed bars. WARNINGS: the same rule measured on 5m bars for this exact watchlist came out WORSE THAN RANDOM and loss-making even at zero cost, and on Tadawul it ranked 14th of 15 with NEGATIVE per-trade expectancy -- which is why the Saudi tracker deliberately still runs ema_cross. Do not copy this block into config-sa.json.
notes: purification_pct is the fraction of each realized profit set aside (0.1 = 10%). Edit any value here and commit/push; the next scheduled run picks it up automatically. sar_per_usd uses SAR's fixed peg to the dollar. ntfy_topic is reused from the PC version so your existing phone subscription keeps working without resubscribing.
